taskChanges.newValue: Config electron-builder cho win/mac/linux da xong + valid. Icon app render bang resvg (resources/icon.png, tro win.icon/mac.icon vao day de electron-builder tu convert). entitlements.mac.plist tao (JIT + network.client). NOTICE/LICENSE/licenses da co. Da them author vao package.json. Build --win --dir chay tot toi buoc cuoi: rebuild native OK, tai electron 100%, chi fail EPERM khi rename dist\win-unpacked.tmp -> dist\win-unpacked (quirk quyen thu muc cua sandbox, KHONG phai loi config). Installer that (NSIS/dmg/AppImage) can CI runner theo tung OS; mac con can Apple Developer notarize - khong lam duoc tu may Windows nay.
